findings.finding: The interaction diagram shows a single undifferentiated flow with `requireRole("manager")` as the only auth step, with no separate branch for GET /doctors. A developer reading only this diagram could mistakenly apply the manager role check to GET /doctors, conflicting with the presence-only pattern documented in security-design.md.
findings.required_action: Add a second flow branch in the diagram distinguishing the POST path (requireRole("manager") → Zod parse → handler) from the GET path (presence-only check → handler), matching the explicit guidance in security-design.md.
